lines.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations,
ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name;
bring an offering and enter His courts.
Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
tremble before Him, all the earth.
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!”
The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved;
He will judge the peoples with equity.

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Adoration of the Magi — the kings of distant peoples kneeling with their gifts before the Child, ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_geslachten

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba — the queen holding out a tall golden vessel to the seated king against a ground of tooled gold, bring an offering and enter His courts
pictures.name: pd_witz_offer

pictures.scene: Albrecht Dürer, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing on the throne in the blaze of light while the crowned elders kneel and the multitude in white robes hold up their palms, worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness
pictures.name: pd_durer_aanbid

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, View of Dordrecht — the church tower and the windmills standing firm over the wide river under a great sky, the LORD reigns, the world is firmly established and cannot be moved
pictures.name: pd_goyen_wereld

pictures.scene: Riccardo Quartararo, The Archangel Michael — the archangel in armour holding the balance level with the devil under his feet, He will judge the peoples with equity, let the heavens be glad
pictures.name: pd_quartararo_recht
